en.text: The disruption risk at Chubu Centrair over the next five days is rated Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswinds.
From 11/15 09:00 to 11/16 15:00, the airport forecast (TAF) shows a mean wind of 22 kt and crosswind of 10.6 kt, and the disruption risk is Low for all periods before 11/19 09:00.
During 11/19 09:00–15:00, three of six models rate strong winds at Medium or above, with the European model showing a crosswind of 30.4 kt.

During 11/20 03:00–09:00, five of six models rate strong winds at Medium or above, with the German model and US model showing crosswinds of 32.7 kt and 32.4 kt respectively, and the European ensemble indicating a 92% chance of gusts over 29 kt.

From 11/19 21:00 to 11/20 09:00, four of six models rate the risk at Medium or above, with gusts up to 59.1 kt in the German model, estimated gusts of 45.4 kt in the US AI model, and a 94% chance of gusts over 29 kt in the European ensemble.
